description: LT1054 charge pump (bipolar, 100 mA, 25 kHz; lower output resistance, more quiescent current)

source.licence: values read from the manufacturer's data sheet

package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: TI LT1054 data sheet SLVS033G (rev. July 2015), Pin Functions, PDIP: FB/SHDN 1, CAP+ 2, GND 3, CAP- 4, VOUT 5, VREF 6, OSC 7, VCC 8. The pump's caps and diodes are drawn parts (D-226).

note: A behavioural model, not the chip's circuit: the figures read from the maker's sheet (pump frequency, output resistance, voltage drop, supply current) drive Solum Builder's own model of a charge pump, switching ripple included (D-093).

rating_sources.vs_max: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): Absolute Maximum Ratings, supply voltage 16 V for unregulated circuits (recommended 3.5 V to 15 V)

param_sources.f_pump: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): oscillator 25 kHz typ (Electrical Characteristics, 15-35 kHz); the oscillator's Q and not-Q drive the switches directly (Functional Block Diagram), so the pump runs at the oscillator frequency
param_sources.r_out: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): output resistance 10 ohms typ, slope for I_O = 10 mA to 100 mA (Electrical Characteristics)
param_sources.v_drop: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): voltage loss 0.35 V typ at I_O = 10 mA (Electrical Characteristics, C_IN = C_OUT = 100 uF tantalum) less 10 mA x 10 ohms: the bipolar switches' own drop
param_sources.i_q: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): supply current 2.5 mA typ at I_O = 0, V_CC = 3.5 V (Electrical Characteristics)
param_sources.c_pump: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): CI = CO = 100 uF tantalum for the voltage loss tests (Electrical Characteristics; TI calls the flying cap CIN, from CAP+ to CAP-)

datasheet.source: Texas Instruments LT1054 data sheet, SLVS033G (rev. July 2015): voltage loss 1.1 V typ at I_O = 100 mA (Electrical Characteristics), so -5.9 V from 7 V
